themes.title: AI infrastructure buildout starts to fray
themes.summary: The hyperscaler capex machine is hitting the economics of the physical world. Microsoft walked away from a UK capacity deal with neocloud Nscale, and The Information sees a neocloud shakeout that would concentrate risk on Nvidia. For buyers, this is the first real sign of pricing leverage returning.
themes.angle: The $10tn buildout meets physics — watch capacity repricing and Nvidia demand concentration.

themes.title: AI trade selloff into Mag 7 earnings week
themes.summary: The AI trade is at a turning point as Big Tech earnings approach. Japanese and Taiwanese markets are pricing AI-viability worries, and the FT flags Meta's print as the confidence test. Hyperscaler spending guidance is now the single biggest swing factor for the sector.
themes.angle: Earnings week decides whether the AI capex story holds — a board-level risk item.

themes.title: Anthropic puts 5% of shares into public benefit fund
themes.summary: Anthropic PBC will move 5% of its shares into a new public benefit fund to fund donations addressing the public good, including AI's impact on the job market. It is a governance innovation that pre-empts labor-market backlash and gives boards a template for institutionalizing AI responsibility.
themes.angle: Frontier labs are institutionalizing AI responsibility — a governance model boards should study.

themes.title: Frontier security and agentic AI
themes.summary: Two stories define the frontier's new risk surface: an OpenAI engineer was arrested over an alleged covert recording device in an executive conference room, and Anthropic is turning to lawyers to define how AI agents can legally strike deals. As agents act for humans, contract law and corporate security are becoming AI problems.
themes.angle: Agentic AI's next bottleneck is legal, not technical.

themes.title: GCC: Abu Dhabi and UAE AI momentum
themes.summary: Abu Dhabi is in talks to sell technology to US cities, a sign the Gulf is becoming an AI exporter rather than just an importer. The UAE also hosts the region's first 6G Summit in the AI Era, Dubai trialled Glydways' AI driverless pods, and a UAE platform consolidated regulatory compliance onto AI.
themes.angle: The Gulf is now selling AI to the West — a narrative flip worth leading with.

themes.title: AI value realization under scrutiny
themes.summary: The ROI question is getting louder: Futurism reports enterprises cutting AI budgets over low-quality output, Accenture is selling its China operations amid AI-impact questions, and Europe's industrial giants are splitting between software and hardware bets. The Big Four are also fighting for India's $2bn GCC work.
themes.angle: The 'AI slop' backlash is a real procurement signal, not noise.

themes.angle: Saudi is building sovereign AI infrastructure — a GCC enterprise opportunity.

themes.title: AI-driven global growth debate
themes.summary: An FT survey of 94 economists points to an AI-driven global surge with benefits reaching beyond the US and China, while Reuters argues AI is not Asia's only game. The macro question is whether AI lifts all economies or concentrates gains in the hyperscaler hubs.
themes.angle: Economists see AI lifting global growth — but the distribution question is open.
